name: adaptive-form-agent
description: Adaptive Form Agent - Chrome extension foundation

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:copy && npm run build:ts
scripts.build:test: esbuild tests/interaction.test.entry.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=tests/.dist/interaction.test.mjs --external:jsdom && esbuild tests/integration.test.entry.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=tests/.dist/integration.test.mjs --external:jsdom && esbuild tests/agent.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=tests/.dist/agent.test.mjs && esbuild tests/bot.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=tests/.dist/bot.test.mjs && esbuild tests/bot-runner.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=tests/.dist/bot-runner.test.mjs && esbuild tests/complex-form-skip-diagnosis.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=tests/.dist/complex-form-skip-diagnosis.test.mjs --external:jsdom && esbuild tests/matching-improvements.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=tests/.dist/matching-improvements.test.mjs
scripts.watch: npm run build && esbuild src/background/service-worker.ts src/content/content-script.ts src/popup/popup.ts --bundle --outdir=dist --outbase=src --format=esm --target=chrome120 --sourcemap --watch
scripts.test: npm run build:test && node --no-warnings --test tests/semantics.test.ts tests/test-page.test.ts tests/.dist/agent.test.mjs tests/.dist/bot.test.mjs tests/.dist/bot-runner.test.mjs tests/.dist/integration.test.mjs tests/.dist/interaction.test.mjs tests/.dist/complex-form-skip-diagnosis.test.mjs tests/.dist/matching-improvements.test.mjs
